words.enDefinition: a card that draws payments directly from a bank account

examples.en: I used my debit card to buy a notebook from the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我用「借记卡」在学校商店买了本笔记本。

examples.en: The bank sent me a debit card after I opened my student account.
examples.zh: 学生账户开好后，银行寄给我一张「借记卡」。

words.enDefinition: a debit card that spends money loaded in advance

examples.en: My host family asked whether my prepaid debit card could be used for groceries.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭问我的「预付式借记卡」能不能用来买食品杂货。

examples.en: I checked the balance on my prepaid debit card before paying for the train.
examples.zh: 付火车票钱前，我查了「预付式借记卡」的余额。

collocations: pay with a prepaid debit card

words.enDefinition: the person to whom a payment card is issued

examples.en: The form says the cardholder should check the total before signing the receipt.
examples.zh: 表格上说，「持卡人」签收据之前应先核对总金额。

examples.en: The shop asked the cardholder to contact the bank about the declined payment.
examples.zh: 商店请「持卡人」就付款被拒一事联系银行。

words.enDefinition: an organisation that provides a payment card to a customer

examples.en: I contacted the card issuer after the replacement card went to my old address.
examples.zh: 补发的卡寄到了旧地址，我联系了「发卡机构」。

examples.en: The receipt gave me the shop's name but not the name of the card issuer.
examples.zh: 收据上有商店名称，但没有「发卡机构」的名称。

words.enDefinition: the name printed on or associated with a payment card

examples.en: The checkout page says the cardholder name must match what is on the card.
examples.zh: 结账页面说，「持卡人姓名」应与卡片上的姓名一致。

examples.en: I checked the cardholder name before submitting the order for my course books.
examples.zh: 在提交教材订单前，我核对了「持卡人姓名」。

words.enDefinition: the number that identifies a particular payment card

examples.en: The cashier kept the receipt, which showed only part of my card number.
examples.zh: 收银员收走了收据，上面只显示了我的部分「银行卡号」。

examples.en: I checked the card number in the app after my new card arrived.
examples.zh: 新卡到了以后，我在应用里核对了「银行卡号」。

words.enDefinition: the date after which a card is no longer valid

examples.en: The form asked for the card expiry date when I renewed my bus pass.
examples.zh: 我续办公交卡时，表格要求填「银行卡到期日」。

examples.en: I noticed the card expiry date was before the end of my exchange semester.
examples.zh: 我注意到「银行卡到期日」早于交换学期结束的日期。

words.enDefinition: a short code used to verify a card payment

examples.en: The official checkout asked for the card verification code before confirming my order.
examples.zh: 正规结账页面在确认我的订单前，要求输入「卡片安全码」。

examples.en: The bank's guide explains where to find the card verification code on each card.
examples.zh: 银行指南说明了在不同卡片上哪里可以看到「卡片安全码」。

words.enDefinition: the postal code linked to a payment card's billing address

examples.en: The form rejected my billing postcode because I had entered the delivery address instead.
examples.zh: 我填成了收货地址，所以表单不接受我的「账单地址邮编」。

examples.en: I checked the billing postcode after moving to a flat closer to campus.
examples.zh: 搬到离学校更近的公寓后，我核对了「账单地址邮编」。

words.enDefinition: the personal number used to verify someone using a card

examples.en: The terminal asked for my card PIN when I inserted the debit card.
examples.zh: 我插入借记卡时，终端提示输入「银行卡密码」。

examples.en: My bank showed where to find the card PIN in its secure app.
examples.zh: 银行说明了在安全应用里哪里能查看「银行卡密码」。

words.enDefinition: a way to view or receive a reminder of a card PIN

examples.en: I asked about a PIN reminder when I visited the branch after class.
examples.zh: 下课去银行网点时，我问了「密码提醒」的事。

examples.en: The app offered a PIN reminder, but I waited until I got home.
examples.zh: 应用提供「密码提醒」功能，但我等到回家才打开。

words.enDefinition: to create a new personal identification number for a card

examples.en: The bank's help page explains how to reset your PIN after it gets locked.
examples.zh: 银行帮助页说明了密码锁定后怎样「重设银行卡密码」。

examples.en: The banking booklet explains where to reset your PIN if you've forgotten the old one.
examples.zh: 银行手册说明了忘记旧密码时去哪里「重设银行卡密码」。

collocations: reset your PIN in the app

words.enDefinition: to enable a new payment card so it can be used

examples.en: The welcome letter explains how to activate your card before using it in stores.
examples.zh: 欢迎信说明了在商店用卡前怎么「激活银行卡」。

examples.en: I read the section called activate your card while waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 等公交时，我读了标题为「激活银行卡」的那一节。

collocations: activate your card in the app

words.enDefinition: a new card issued in place of an existing card

examples.en: My replacement card arrived just before I left for the summer exchange programme.
examples.zh: 我出发参加暑期交换项目之前，「补发的银行卡」正好到了。

examples.en: I asked whether the replacement card would be sent to the bank branch.
examples.zh: 我问「补发的银行卡」会不会寄到银行网点。

words.enDefinition: a payment card whose expiry date has passed

examples.en: I accidentally picked the expired card from my wallet when I bought lunch.
examples.zh: 买午饭时，我不小心从钱包里拿出了「已过期的银行卡」。

examples.en: The app marked my expired card separately from the one I use now.
examples.zh: 应用把「已过期的银行卡」和我现在用的卡分开标注了。

words.enDefinition: a payment card provided for use for a limited period

examples.en: The branch offered a temporary card while my replacement was in the mail.
examples.zh: 补发卡还在邮寄中时，网点给了我一张「临时银行卡」。

examples.en: I asked what the temporary card could be used for during my visit.
examples.zh: 到网点时，我问了「临时银行卡」能用在哪些地方。

words.enDefinition: a card whose payment details are provided in digital form

examples.en: My bank showed a virtual card in the app while the physical one was being sent.
examples.zh: 实体卡邮寄期间，银行在应用里显示了一张「虚拟银行卡」。

examples.en: I compared the name on the virtual card with the name on my bank account.
examples.zh: 我把「虚拟银行卡」上的姓名和银行账户上的姓名核对了一下。

words.enDefinition: a digital payment card intended for only one transaction

examples.en: The bank's guide explains what happens to a single-use virtual card after a purchase.
examples.zh: 银行指南解释了买完东西以后，「一次性虚拟卡」会如何处理。

examples.en: I asked whether a refund could still go through on a single-use virtual card.
examples.zh: 我问用「一次性虚拟卡」付款以后，退款还能不能到账。

collocations: pay with a single-use virtual card

words.enDefinition: a tangible card issued for making payments or withdrawals

examples.en: I carried a physical card while my phone was charging in my room.
examples.zh: 手机留在房间里充电时，我带了一张「实体银行卡」出门。

examples.en: The cashier asked whether I wanted to use my physical card or a digital wallet.
examples.zh: 收银员问我要用「实体银行卡」还是电子钱包。

words.enDefinition: an additional card linked to someone else's main account

examples.en: The bank said a supplementary card could have a different name from the main account.
examples.zh: 银行说「附属银行卡」上的姓名可以和主账户不同。

examples.en: My family asked what changes appeared on the statement when using a supplementary card.
examples.zh: 家里人问，用「附属银行卡」以后账单会有哪些变化。

words.enDefinition: the process of sending an issued payment card to a customer

examples.en: I checked the card delivery estimate because I was leaving for reading week.
examples.zh: 我复习周要离校，所以查了「银行卡配送」的预计时间。

examples.en: The app said card delivery had been delayed because of the public holiday.
examples.zh: 应用说，公共假日期间「银行卡配送」延误了。

words.enDefinition: the process of picking up a card at a stated location

examples.en: I asked which documents were needed for card collection at the bank branch.
examples.zh: 我问「到指定地点领卡」时，要带哪些材料去银行网点。

examples.en: The email says card collection is available on weekdays before the branch closes.
examples.zh: 邮件说工作日网点关门前都可以「到指定地点领卡」。

words.enDefinition: the contract setting the terms for using a payment card

examples.en: I read the cardholder agreement after the bank emailed it to my account.
examples.zh: 银行发邮件把「持卡人协议」寄给我后，我读了一遍。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where card fees were listed in the cardholder agreement.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我，「持卡人协议」里哪里列了银行卡收费。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount a cardholder may spend within a specified period

examples.en: I asked about the card spending limit before placing a large order for textbooks.
examples.zh: 一次性订很多教材之前，我询问了「银行卡消费限额」。

examples.en: The app shows the card spending limit next to my payment settings.
examples.zh: 应用在付款设置旁边显示了「银行卡消费限额」。

words.enDefinition: the most that can be spent on purchases in one day

examples.en: The student account summary shows a daily purchase limit for my debit card.
examples.zh: 学生账户摘要列出了我的借记卡「单日消费上限」。

examples.en: We checked the daily purchase limit after the large stationery order was declined.
examples.zh: 大笔文具订单被拒之后，我们核对了「单日消费上限」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount allowed under specified contactless payment rules

examples.en: I asked whether our bank's contactless limit applied to phone payments as well.
examples.zh: 我问银行的「非接触支付限额」是否也适用于手机支付。

examples.en: The app has a page showing the contactless limit for each of my cards.
examples.zh: 应用有一页会显示我每张卡的「非接触支付限额」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum cash that can be taken out within a stated period

examples.en: I looked up the cash withdrawal limit before leaving for the class field trip.
examples.zh: 出发参加课程实地考察前，我查了「取现限额」。

examples.en: The bank confirmed that my cash withdrawal limit would stay the same after graduation.
examples.zh: 银行确认我毕业后「取现限额」仍保持不变。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount allowed in a single payment

examples.en: The payment page displayed a per-transaction limit below the box for the amount.
examples.zh: 付款页面在金额输入框下方显示了「单笔交易限额」。

examples.en: I asked whether the per-transaction limit was different for purchases made outside the country.
examples.zh: 我问境外消费的「单笔交易限额」是不是不同。

words.enDefinition: settings that restrict when, where, or how a card is used

examples.en: I looked at the spending controls before travelling to another country for a conference.
examples.zh: 出国参加会议前，我查看了「消费管控设置」。

examples.en: My bank's spending controls let me choose which types of payments to allow.
examples.zh: 我银行的「消费管控设置」可以选择允许哪些付款类型。

words.enDefinition: to temporarily stop new transactions from being made with a card

examples.en: The bank's app shows where to freeze your card if you cannot find it.
examples.zh: 如果卡找不到了，银行应用会显示在哪里「暂时冻结银行卡」。

examples.en: The guide explains what happens to pending payments when you freeze your card.
examples.zh: 指南说明了「暂时冻结银行卡」后，待处理的付款会怎样。

collocations: use the app to freeze your card

words.enDefinition: to restore use of a payment card after a temporary freeze

examples.en: The official help page says where to unfreeze your card once you find it.
examples.zh: 官方帮助页说明了找到卡后在哪里「解除银行卡临时冻结」。

examples.en: My friend asked what unfreeze your card meant on her bank's app.
examples.zh: 朋友问她银行应用里的「解除银行卡临时冻结」是什么意思。

collocations: ask how to unfreeze your card
use the app to unfreeze your card

words.enDefinition: to tell the issuer a card cannot be found

examples.en: I used the bank's number to report a lost card after leaving the station.
examples.zh: 离开车站后，我打银行电话「挂失银行卡」。

examples.en: The adviser explained how to report a lost card while I was overseas.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了人在海外怎么「挂失银行卡」。

collocations: call to report a lost card
need to report a lost card

words.enDefinition: a check to confirm that a card or card user is genuine

examples.en: The checkout screen mentioned card authentication before my textbook order was approved.
examples.zh: 教材订单获批前，结账页面提到了「刷卡交易身份验证」。

examples.en: I asked the bank why card authentication was requested again for the purchase.
examples.zh: 我问银行，为什么这笔消费要再次做「刷卡交易身份验证」。

words.enDefinition: a code valid for a single use or short session

examples.en: The bank's secure app asked me for a one-time passcode to confirm the purchase.
examples.zh: 银行的安全应用要求输入「一次性验证码」确认交易。

examples.en: I waited for the one-time passcode that the payment page told me to expect.
examples.zh: 付款页面提示会发「一次性验证码」，我就等着接收。

words.enDefinition: a page displaying information or confirmation about a payment

examples.en: I checked the total before leaving the payment confirmation screen on my phone.
examples.zh: 离开手机上的「付款确认页面」前，我核对了总金额。

examples.en: The payment confirmation screen showed my order number and the amount I had paid.
examples.zh: 「付款确认页面」显示了订单号和已付金额。

collocations: return to the payment confirmation screen

words.enDefinition: a device that accepts and processes payments at a checkout

examples.en: The shop put a payment terminal next to the self-service printer on campus.
examples.zh: 商店把一台「刷卡终端」放在校园自助打印机旁。

examples.en: The cashier turned the payment terminal towards me so I could see the amount.
examples.zh: 收银员把「刷卡终端」转向我，好让我看到金额。

collocations: enter a PIN on the payment terminal

words.enDefinition: a device that reads information from a payment card

examples.en: The card reader on the bus did not respond when I first tried.
examples.zh: 我第一次刷时，公交车上的「读卡器」没反应。

examples.en: The market stall had a small card reader connected to the seller's phone.
examples.zh: 集市摊位有个小「读卡器」，连着摊主的手机。

words.enDefinition: a machine customers use to scan and pay for purchases themselves

examples.en: I chose a self-checkout terminal because I only needed two items for dinner.
examples.zh: 我只买了两样晚饭食材，所以选了「自助结账机」。

examples.en: The self-checkout terminal asked whether I wanted a paper receipt for my groceries.
examples.zh: 「自助结账机」问我这笔杂货购物要不要纸质收据。

words.enDefinition: to pay by holding a card or device near a reader

examples.en: The sign showed that passengers could tap to pay on the city tram.
examples.zh: 标牌显示，乘客在市区有轨电车上可以「碰一下付款」。

examples.en: The cashier asked whether I wanted to tap to pay or insert the card.
examples.zh: 收银员问我想「碰一下付款」还是插卡。

collocations: tap to pay with your phone

words.enDefinition: to briefly hold your card close to a contactless reader

examples.en: The sign said "tap your card here" near the front door of the bus.
examples.zh: 公交车前门附近的提示牌写着「把卡碰一下读卡器」。

examples.en: The screen says tap your card once the price appears below the logo.
examples.zh: 屏幕提示，价格在标志下方显示后就「把卡碰一下读卡器」。

collocations: tap your card on the reader

words.enDefinition: a curved-wave symbol showing a device or card supports contactless use

examples.en: I looked for the contactless symbol on the reader near the shop entrance.
examples.zh: 我在商店入口旁的读卡器上找「非接触支付标志」。

examples.en: The cashier pointed out the contactless symbol on the new terminal before I paid.
examples.zh: 我付钱前，收银员指出了新终端上的「非接触支付标志」。

words.enDefinition: a card that can pay without insertion into a reader

examples.en: My bank sent a contactless card when it replaced the one I lost.
examples.zh: 我的卡丢了，银行补寄来一张「非接触式银行卡」。

examples.en: I used a contactless card at the campus café before my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 我早课前在校园咖啡馆用「非接触式银行卡」付了款。

words.enDefinition: payment by reading a card chip and entering its PIN

examples.en: The café's terminal offered chip and PIN after my first attempt was declined.
examples.zh: 我第一次付款被拒后，咖啡馆的终端提示可用「芯片加密码付款」。

examples.en: My friend asked what chip and PIN meant on the sign at checkout.
examples.zh: 朋友问收银台标牌上的「芯片加密码付款」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a device that reads a card through its embedded chip

examples.en: The cashier said the chip reader was working at the next register.
examples.zh: 收银员说，另一台收银机的「芯片卡读取器」能用。

examples.en: I used the chip reader after the contactless option did not appear.
examples.zh: 没显示非接触选项，我便改用了「芯片卡读取器」。

words.enDefinition: to put a payment card into the reader's slot

examples.en: The machine says insert your card when it is ready to take payment.
examples.zh: 机器准备收款时，屏幕会显示「将银行卡插入读卡器」。

examples.en: I did not expect to see "insert your card" on the screen at checkout.
examples.zh: 结账时没想到屏幕提示「将银行卡插入读卡器」。

collocations: insert your card into the reader

words.enDefinition: to pass a card's magnetic stripe through a reader

examples.en: The instruction on the old machine said swipe your card to continue.
examples.zh: 旧机器提示，要继续就得「刷银行卡磁条」。

examples.en: The label said "swipe your card," but the cashier pointed me to the chip reader.
examples.zh: 标签写着「刷银行卡磁条」，但收银员指了指芯片读取器。

collocations: swipe your card through the reader

words.enDefinition: the strip on a card that stores information a reader can detect

examples.en: The magnetic stripe was scratched after my card spent months loose in my bag.
examples.zh: 卡在包里散放了几个月，「银行卡磁条」刮花了。

examples.en: The cashier could not read the magnetic stripe on my worn student debit card.
examples.zh: 我学生借记卡磨损了，收银员读不出「银行卡磁条」。

words.enDefinition: a payment where the card or contactless device is used at a terminal

examples.en: My bank labelled the campus bookshop payment as a card-present transaction in the app.
examples.zh: 银行在应用里把在校园书店付的钱标为「现场刷卡交易」。

examples.en: I asked about the phrase card-present transaction because it appeared on my statement.
examples.zh: 账单上出现了「现场刷卡交易」，我就问了这个说法。

words.enDefinition: a card payment made without presenting the card at a terminal

examples.en: The online textbook order appeared as a card-not-present transaction in my bank app.
examples.zh: 在线教材订单在银行应用里显示为「无卡支付交易」。

examples.en: The adviser explained why an online order was marked as a card-not-present transaction.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么在线订单会标为「无卡支付交易」。

words.enDefinition: a checkout that takes card payments without accepting cash

examples.en: I moved to a card-only checkout because I had left my wallet upstairs.
examples.zh: 钱包落在楼上，我就换到了「仅限刷卡的结账台」。

examples.en: The card-only checkout at our shop accepts both phone payments and physical cards.
examples.zh: 我们店的「仅限刷卡的结账台」既收手机支付也收实体卡。

words.enDefinition: forms of payment that a business agrees to take

examples.en: The sign at the café lists its accepted payment methods beside the opening hours.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆的牌子在营业时间旁列出了「支持的支付方式」。

examples.en: I checked the accepted payment methods before ordering a ticket for our class trip.
examples.zh: 我订班级出游的票之前，查了「支持的支付方式」。

words.enDefinition: the smallest purchase amount a merchant accepts by card

examples.en: The café sign listed a minimum card spend just below the drinks menu.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆牌子在饮品菜单下写了「刷卡最低消费」。

examples.en: I asked how much the minimum card spend was before ordering one coffee.
examples.zh: 只点一杯咖啡之前，我问了「刷卡最低消费」是多少。

words.enDefinition: an extra charge for paying with a card

examples.en: The ticket website showed a card surcharge before it asked me to pay.
examples.zh: 购票网站在要求付款前显示了「刷卡附加费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the card surcharge would apply if I used a debit card.
examples.zh: 我问用借记卡是否也要付「刷卡附加费」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for changing a payment amount from one currency to another

examples.en: The statement lists a currency conversion fee beside my bookstore purchase abroad.
examples.zh: 账单在我国外书店的消费旁列了一笔「货币兑换手续费」。

examples.en: I asked how the currency conversion fee was displayed in the app.
examples.zh: 我问「货币兑换手续费」在应用中是怎么显示的。

words.enDefinition: a card payment processed across national borders

examples.en: The app notified me about an international card payment from the exam website.
examples.zh: 应用通知我，考试网站有一笔「跨境银行卡付款」。

examples.en: I checked which exchange rate appeared next to the international card payment on my statement.
examples.zh: 我核对了账单上「跨境银行卡付款」旁显示的是哪个汇率。

words.enDefinition: a payment made with card details on a website or app

examples.en: I made an online card payment for my textbook rental before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，我为租教材做了一笔「网上银行卡付款」。

examples.en: The university portal sent an email after my online card payment was approved.
examples.zh: 我的「网上银行卡付款」获批后，学校系统发了一封邮件。

words.enDefinition: the process of completing a purchase on a website or app

examples.en: The shop gave me an option to choose delivery during online checkout.
examples.zh: 商店让我在「网上结账」时选择送货方式。

examples.en: I paused at online checkout to check my delivery details and discount code.
examples.zh: 我在「网上结账」时停了一下，核对收货信息和优惠码。

words.enDefinition: a webpage where customers review a purchase and enter payment details

examples.en: My address was shown on the checkout page next to the delivery option.
examples.zh: 「结账页面」在送货选项旁显示了我的地址。

examples.en: I checked the order total on the checkout page before buying my train ticket.
examples.zh: 买火车票前，我在「结账页面」核对了订单总额。

words.enDefinition: payment details retained by a website, app or account

examples.en: The app showed one saved payment method when I ordered dinner after class.
examples.zh: 下课后点晚饭时，应用显示一种「已保存的付款方式」。

examples.en: I removed a saved payment method before handing the old phone to my sister.
examples.zh: 把旧手机给姐姐之前，我删除了一种「已保存的付款方式」。

words.enDefinition: the payment option selected automatically unless another is chosen

examples.en: The checkout used my default payment method when I booked the coach ticket.
examples.zh: 订长途客车票时，结账系统用了我的「默认付款方式」。

examples.en: I checked which card was my default payment method before renewing the subscription.
examples.zh: 续订之前，我核对了哪张卡是我的「默认付款方式」。

words.enDefinition: a card whose payment details are kept in a merchant's records

examples.en: The gym said it could use the card on file for my membership renewal.
examples.zh: 健身房说，会员续期可以用「已留存的银行卡」付款。

examples.en: The ticket app showed a card on file that I no longer used.
examples.zh: 购票应用显示有一张我已不用的「已留存的银行卡」。

words.enDefinition: to change how future payments will be made

examples.en: The service emailed me a reminder that said update your payment method before renewal.
examples.zh: 服务发邮件提醒我，续订前要「更新付款方式」。

examples.en: The website shows how to update your payment method in the account settings.
examples.zh: 网站说明了在账户设置里如何「更新付款方式」。

collocations: need to update your payment method
ask how to update your payment method

words.enDefinition: information used to identify a payer and issue a bill

examples.en: I checked my billing details before the student software renewal went through online.
examples.zh: 在线续订学生软件之前，我核对了自己的「账单信息」。

examples.en: The website asked whether my billing details were different from the delivery information.
examples.zh: 网站问我的「账单信息」是否和收货信息不同。

words.enDefinition: a difference between an entered billing address and the address on record

examples.en: A billing address mismatch stopped my train ticket order on the final screen.
examples.zh: 最后一步，「账单地址不匹配」让我的火车票订单没能提交。

examples.en: The error message said billing address mismatch after I entered my new address.
examples.zh: 输完新地址后，错误消息显示「账单地址不匹配」。

collocations: check for a billing address mismatch

words.enDefinition: shown when a payment card is not approved

examples.en: The screen said card declined after I tried to pay for my lunch.
examples.zh: 我试着付午饭的钱后，屏幕显示「银行卡付款被拒」。

examples.en: I asked the cashier what card declined meant on the small display.
examples.zh: 我问收银员，小屏幕上的「银行卡付款被拒」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the explanation for why a payment did not go through

examples.en: The clerk said only the bank could tell me the decline reason for my payment.
examples.zh: 办事员说，只有银行能告诉我这笔「付款被拒原因」。

examples.en: The app showed the decline reason next to the attempted purchase at the bookshop.
examples.zh: 应用在书店消费尝试旁显示了「付款被拒原因」。

words.enDefinition: the issuer's approval for a particular card transaction

examples.en: The shop was still waiting for card authorization when the register stopped responding.
examples.zh: 收银台没反应时，商店还在等「银行卡交易授权」。

examples.en: My bank displayed the card authorization before the purchase appeared on my statement.
examples.zh: 这笔消费出现在账单前，我的银行先显示了「银行卡交易授权」。

words.enDefinition: a temporary reservation of funds or credit for a card payment

examples.en: The hotel mentioned an authorization hold before I checked in for the conference.
examples.zh: 我去办会议住宿入住时，酒店提到了「预授权冻结」。

examples.en: I asked when the authorization hold would disappear from the list in my app.
examples.zh: 我问「预授权冻结」什么时候会从应用列表里消失。

words.enDefinition: a transaction still waiting to be fully processed and recorded

examples.en: The café purchase was showing as a pending transaction when I checked my phone.
examples.zh: 我看手机时，咖啡馆的消费还显示为一笔「待入账交易」。

examples.en: I matched the pending transaction to the receipt from the campus bookshop.
examples.zh: 我把这笔「待入账交易」和校园书店开的收据对上了。

words.enDefinition: a completed transaction recorded on an account

examples.en: I found the posted transaction listed beside my other purchases from the same day.
examples.zh: 我在同一天其他消费的旁边找到了这笔「已入账交易」。

examples.en: The adviser showed me how to view a posted transaction in the banking app.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了在银行应用里怎么查「已入账交易」。

words.enDefinition: the amount set aside on an account before a transaction finishes

examples.en: The hold amount was higher than the final bill for the room.
examples.zh: 房间的「暂时冻结金额」比最终账单还高。

examples.en: I checked the hold amount on my card after returning the hired bike.
examples.zh: 把租来的自行车还回去后，我查看了卡上的「暂时冻结金额」。

words.enDefinition: to remove a temporary restriction on money or available credit

examples.en: I asked when the shop could release a hold from the cancelled order.
examples.zh: 我询问了商店什么时候能为取消的订单「解除金额冻结」。

examples.en: The bank explained how long it might take to release a hold on my card.
examples.zh: 银行解释了卡上要等多久才可能「解除金额冻结」。

words.enDefinition: a recorded date and time attached to a transaction

examples.en: I checked the transaction timestamp to see which bus journey the charge covered.
examples.zh: 我查看了「交易时间戳」，想知道这笔费用是哪一趟公交的。

examples.en: The adviser asked for the transaction timestamp before looking in the payment system.
examples.zh: 顾问先问了「交易时间戳」，再到支付系统里查。

words.enDefinition: a list of past transactions made with a specific card

examples.en: I checked the card transaction history against the receipts from our group trip.
examples.zh: 我拿小组出游的收据和「银行卡交易记录」逐一核对。

examples.en: The app filters my card transaction history by date when I search for a purchase.
examples.zh: 我查找某笔消费时，应用会按日期筛选「银行卡交易记录」。

words.enDefinition: the text that identifies a merchant on a card statement

examples.en: I searched for the merchant descriptor because I did not recognise the name.
examples.zh: 我不认得这个名字，就搜了一下「账单商户显示名」。

examples.en: The bank explained why the merchant descriptor differed from the name on the shop sign.
examples.zh: 银行解释了为什么「账单商户显示名」和店门招牌上的名称不同。

words.enDefinition: the first transaction to which a later refund or correction refers

examples.en: The refund notice listed the original transaction under the new receipt number.
examples.zh: 退款通知在新收据号下列出了「原始交易」。

examples.en: The adviser asked which original transaction the second charge was linked to.
examples.zh: 顾问问这笔额外收费对应的是哪笔「原始交易」。

words.enDefinition: a record confirming a payment made by card at a merchant

examples.en: I kept the card receipt because my flatmate had paid for half the order.
examples.zh: 我留着「刷卡凭条」，因为订单有一半的钱是室友出的。

examples.en: The cashier asked whether I needed a copy of the card receipt.
examples.zh: 收银员问我需不需要一份「刷卡凭条」副本。

words.enDefinition: a receipt showing the purchased items and amounts separately

examples.en: I asked for an itemized receipt because three of us had shared the order.
examples.zh: 因为这份订单是我们三个人一起买的，我要了张「分项收据」。

examples.en: The itemized receipt helped me check which books I had actually been charged for.
examples.zh: 「分项收据」帮我核对了实际付费的是哪些书。

words.enDefinition: a second card charge for the same purchase

examples.en: I noticed a duplicate card charge after checking my receipts from the café.
examples.zh: 核对咖啡馆的收据后，我发现了一笔「重复扣款」。

examples.en: The shop asked for both order numbers to look into the duplicate card charge.
examples.zh: 商店要了两个订单号，来调查是不是发生了「重复扣款」。

words.enDefinition: an account entry a customer cannot identify from the details shown

examples.en: I checked an unrecognized transaction after the bank showed a different shop name.
examples.zh: 银行显示了不同的商户名，我就查了一笔「不明交易」。

examples.en: The adviser asked for the date of the unrecognized transaction on my statement.
examples.zh: 顾问问对账单上「不明交易」是哪一天。

words.enDefinition: card use not authorised by the person entitled to approve it

examples.en: The bank asked when I first noticed the unauthorized card transaction in the app.
examples.zh: 银行问我什么时候第一次在应用里发现「未经授权的刷卡交易」。

examples.en: My adviser explained the difference between a late refund and an unauthorized card transaction.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了退款晚到和「未经授权的刷卡交易」有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: a disagreement between a customer and a seller concerning a purchase

examples.en: I saved the email about the merchant dispute with the other order documents.
examples.zh: 我把有关「与商户的付款争议」的邮件和别的订单文件存放在一起。

examples.en: The bank asked what had happened so far in the merchant dispute.
examples.zh: 银行问这起「与商户的付款争议」目前已经发生了什么。

words.enDefinition: to formally question a charge on a card account

examples.en: I asked the bank how to dispute a card charge I did not recognise.
examples.zh: 我问银行，怎么「对卡片扣款提出异议」，那笔交易我认不出来。

examples.en: The adviser explained which documents could help me dispute a card charge.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了哪些文件有助于我「对卡片扣款提出异议」。

collocations: decide to dispute a card charge
contact the bank to dispute a card charge
ask how to dispute a card charge

words.enDefinition: a reversal of a card payment through a formal issuer dispute

examples.en: The bank explained what a chargeback meant after my order never arrived.
examples.zh: 订单一直没送到后，银行解释了什么叫「银行卡交易拒付」。

examples.en: The merchant replied to the chargeback and supplied a copy of the shipping record.
examples.zh: 商户回应了「银行卡交易拒付」，并提供了一份发货记录副本。

words.enDefinition: the latest date allowed for requesting a chargeback

examples.en: I asked the issuer to confirm the chargeback deadline for this particular purchase.
examples.zh: 我请发卡机构确认这一笔消费的「拒付申请截止日」。

examples.en: The chargeback deadline was written at the top of the bank's message.
examples.zh: 「拒付申请截止日」写在银行消息的顶部。

words.enDefinition: a temporary credit while a disputed charge is being investigated

examples.en: I asked whether the provisional credit could change after the bank finished its review.
examples.zh: 我问银行审查结束后，这笔「临时返还款」是否还可能调整。

examples.en: The account showed a provisional credit beside the date of my disputed purchase.
examples.zh: 账户在有争议的消费日期旁显示了一笔「临时返还款」。

words.enDefinition: a transaction that has been undone or cancelled in account records

examples.en: The adviser showed me how to recognise a reversed transaction on my statement.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我怎么识别对账单上「已冲正的交易」。

examples.en: I matched the reversed transaction with the amount on the shop's cancellation notice.
examples.zh: 我把「已冲正的交易」和商店取消通知上的金额对上了。

words.enDefinition: money repaid to the same card used for a purchase

examples.en: I requested a refund to the original card after showing the cashier my receipt.
examples.zh: 我出示收据后，请收银员办理「退回原付款卡的退款」。

examples.en: The receipt showed a refund to the original card even though the bank had replaced it.
examples.zh: 尽管银行已经换发了卡，收据还是显示为「退回原付款卡的退款」。

collocations: request a refund to the original card
process a refund to the original card
receive a refund to the original card

words.enDefinition: return of part of a card payment rather than the whole amount

examples.en: The seller sent a partial card refund for the missing item in my order.
examples.zh: 卖家把订单里漏掉的商品办了「部分退款到卡」。

examples.en: The receipt confirmed the partial card refund before it appeared in my app.
examples.zh: 「部分退款到卡」还没出现在应用里时，收据上已经确认了。

words.enDefinition: a refund has started but the money has not yet arrived

examples.en: The app displayed refund pending beside the returned order from the bookshop.
examples.zh: 应用在书店那笔退货订单旁显示「退款处理中」。

examples.en: The email said refund pending, so I waited to see the updated statement.
examples.zh: 邮件显示「退款处理中」，我就等着看更新后的账单。

words.enDefinition: a reference that identifies a refund in payment records

examples.en: The shop shared a refund reference after receiving my parcel on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 商店周二收到我的退件后，发来一个「退款参考编号」。

examples.en: I asked whether the refund reference would help the bank find the payment.
examples.zh: 我问「退款参考编号」是否能帮助银行找到这笔款项。

words.enDefinition: how long it takes a refund to be completed

examples.en: The website included the refund processing time in its guide to returns.
examples.zh: 网站在退货指南里写了「退款处理时长」。

examples.en: I asked about the refund processing time after the courier collected my order.
examples.zh: 快递员取走退货后，我问了「退款处理时长」。

words.enDefinition: payment for one purchase using more than one method

examples.en: The till allowed a split payment, so I used a gift card and cash.
examples.zh: 收银系统允许「拆分付款」，我就用了礼品卡和现金。

examples.en: I asked whether a split payment would appear as two separate entries on the receipt.
examples.zh: 我问「拆分付款」在收据上会不会分两项列出来。

words.enDefinition: a checkout screen that allows a customer to choose a tip

examples.en: The tip screen appeared before the café payment went through on my phone.
examples.zh: 手机上的咖啡馆付款完成前，出现了「小费选项页面」。

examples.en: I asked the cashier what the options on the tip screen meant.
examples.zh: 我问收银员，「小费选项页面」上的几个选项是什么意思。

collocations: choose an option on the tip screen

words.enDefinition: a tip amount entered manually instead of choosing a preset

examples.en: The tablet let me leave a custom tip rather than choose a percentage.
examples.zh: 平板允许我填「自定小费金额」，不用选预设比例。

examples.en: I checked the custom tip amount before confirming the payment at the counter.
examples.zh: 在柜台确认付款前，我核对了「自定小费金额」。

words.enDefinition: software that stores payment details for electronic use

examples.en: I added my new card to the digital wallet before travelling to class.
examples.zh: 去学校上课之前，我把新卡加进了「数字钱包」。

examples.en: The cashier asked whether our digital wallet supported payments at that particular terminal.
examples.zh: 收银员问我们用的「数字钱包」支持那台终端付款吗。

collocations: add a card to a digital wallet

words.enDefinition: a code used to unlock a digital payment wallet

examples.en: My phone asked for the wallet passcode before showing the payment screen.
examples.zh: 手机要我输入「数字钱包解锁密码」才显示支付界面。

examples.en: I read the help page about a forgotten wallet passcode on my device.
examples.zh: 我在自己的设备上读了忘记「数字钱包解锁密码」的帮助页。

words.enDefinition: the card chosen automatically when several cards are available

examples.en: My phone used the default card when I paid at the campus café.
examples.zh: 我在校园咖啡馆付款时，手机用了「默认付款卡」。

examples.en: I checked the default card before leaving the campus shop with my books.
examples.zh: 带着刚买的教材离开校内商店前，我核对了「默认付款卡」。

words.enDefinition: a payment completed from inside a mobile application

examples.en: I made an in-app payment to book my seat on the airport shuttle.
examples.zh: 我用「应用内付款」预订了去机场的班车座位。

examples.en: The transit service sent a receipt after the in-app payment went through.
examples.zh: 「应用内付款」成功后，公交运营方发来一张收据。

words.enDefinition: a payment made at a merchant's physical location

examples.en: The online offer still required an in-store payment when I picked up the books.
examples.zh: 虽然优惠是在网上领的，但取书时仍要「店内付款」。

examples.en: My bank marked the food purchase as an in-store payment because I bought it at the café.
examples.zh: 食物是在咖啡馆买的，我的银行把这笔标成了「店内付款」。

words.enDefinition: a notification sent when a card payment is attempted or made

examples.en: I got a card payment alert while the shop was printing the receipt.
examples.zh: 商店还在打印收据，我就收到一条「银行卡付款提醒」。

examples.en: My bank lets me choose when I receive a card payment alert.
examples.zh: 我的银行允许我设置什么时候接收「银行卡付款提醒」。

words.enDefinition: the classification used to describe a merchant's line of business

examples.en: The card statement listed a merchant category for each payment I made abroad.
examples.zh: 银行卡账单给我在国外的每笔付款都列了「商户类别」。

examples.en: I asked what the merchant category meant for a purchase from the campus store.
examples.zh: 我问在校园商店买东西时，显示的「商户类别」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a payment taken from a card repeatedly at agreed times

examples.en: I checked which recurring card payment covered my student music subscription that month.
examples.zh: 我查了当月的学生音乐订阅对应哪一笔「定期银行卡扣款」。

examples.en: The portal showed a recurring card payment for the language software I had renewed.
examples.zh: 在线系统显示我续订的语言软件有一笔「定期银行卡扣款」。

collocations: set up a recurring card payment

words.enDefinition: replacing card details with a substitute value for payment processing

examples.en: The bank's leaflet explained card tokenization when I asked about using a digital wallet.
examples.zh: 我问电子钱包怎么用时，银行宣传页介绍了「卡片信息令牌化」。

examples.en: Our class discussed card tokenization in a lesson on common digital payment terms.
examples.zh: 我们在一节讲常见数字支付术语的课里讨论了「卡片信息令牌化」。

words.enDefinition: an email that confirms a payment or records its details

examples.en: I saved the payment confirmation email with the documents for my weekend trip.
examples.zh: 我把「付款确认邮件」和周末旅行的资料放在一起。

examples.en: The payment confirmation email arrived after I had left the campus library.
examples.zh: 我离开学校图书馆之后，才收到了「付款确认邮件」。

words.enDefinition: shown when an attempt to pay could not be completed

examples.en: The website displayed payment failed after the checkout page stopped responding on my phone.
examples.zh: 手机上结账页面不动了，网站显示「付款失败」。

examples.en: The notification said payment failed, so I checked whether an order had been created.
examples.zh: 通知说「付款失败」，我就查了有没有生成订单。

words.enDefinition: to attempt payment with a different card

examples.en: The cashier asked if I wanted to try another card for the purchase.
examples.zh: 收银员问我这笔消费想不想「换张卡试试」。

examples.en: The checkout screen said try another card after rejecting my first payment attempt.
examples.zh: 第一次付款被拒后，结账屏幕提示「换张卡试试」。

words.enDefinition: to choose the debit or credit payment option on a terminal

examples.en: The machine asked me to select debit or credit before showing the amount.
examples.zh: 机器显示金额前，提示我「选择借记或信用付款」。

examples.en: I asked what select debit or credit meant on the store's payment terminal.
examples.zh: 我问店里的支付终端上「选择借记或信用付款」是什么意思。

collocations: prompt to select debit or credit
ask customers to select debit or credit
a screen asking you to select debit or credit

words.enDefinition: indicating that contactless use is turned off for a card

examples.en: The app showed contactless disabled after I checked the card settings at lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时我查看了银行卡设置，应用显示「非接触支付已停用」。

examples.en: I asked why the new card was marked contactless disabled on the settings screen.
examples.zh: 我问新卡为什么在设置页面上标了「非接触支付已停用」。

words.enDefinition: indicating that a card is not enabled for online purchases

examples.en: The message online payments disabled appeared when I tried to renew my software.
examples.zh: 尝试续订软件时，页面显示「在线付款已停用」。

examples.en: I checked the help page after seeing online payments disabled under my card.
examples.zh: 我看到卡片下方有「在线付款已停用」，就去查了帮助页。

collocations: online payments disabled in the app

words.enDefinition: a card payment processed within the same country as the card

examples.en: The statement listed a domestic card payment for the books I ordered locally.
examples.zh: 账单把我在本地订书的款项列为「境内银行卡付款」。

examples.en: I asked which currency was shown for a domestic card payment on my account.
examples.zh: 我问账户上的「境内银行卡付款」会显示哪种货币。

words.enDefinition: accepting cash as the only payment method

examples.en: The stall was cash only, so I couldn't use my card for lunch.
examples.zh: 那个摊位「仅收现金」，所以我没法刷卡买午饭。

examples.en: The sign at the door said cash only during the temporary network outage.
examples.zh: 临时网络中断时，门口的牌子写着「仅收现金」。

words.enDefinition: coins with low values used for small payments

examples.en: I kept some small change for the washing machine in our residence hall.
examples.zh: 我留了些「小额零钱」，准备在宿舍楼用洗衣机。

examples.en: The cashier asked if I had small change because the coin tray was empty.
examples.zh: 收银员问我有没有「小额零钱」，因为零钱盘是空的。

words.enDefinition: cash in the precise amount needed for a purchase

examples.en: The notice asks for exact change when paying for the campus shuttle.
examples.zh: 通知说坐校园班车时请用「正好的零钱」付款。

examples.en: I counted out the exact change before joining the queue for the market stall.
examples.zh: 排到集市摊位的队里之前，我数出了「正好的零钱」。

words.enDefinition: the printed record produced by a store's checkout

examples.en: I put the till receipt in my bag with the second-hand textbooks.
examples.zh: 我把「收银小票」和二手教材一起放进了包里。

examples.en: The shop asked whether the till receipt showed the price before the discount.
examples.zh: 商店问「收银小票」上有没有显示打折前的价格。

words.enDefinition: a response indicating that the customer does not want a receipt

examples.en: I selected no receipt needed after paying for lunch at the campus café.
examples.zh: 我在校园咖啡馆付完午饭钱后选了「不需要收据」。

examples.en: The kiosk offered no receipt needed on the screen before closing the payment.
examples.zh: 结束付款前，自助机在屏幕上给出了「不需要收据」这个选项。

words.enDefinition: to pay the amount remaining from a purchase with a card

examples.en: I used the gift voucher and asked to pay the balance by card.
examples.zh: 我用了礼品券，并问能不能「用银行卡付清余款」。

examples.en: The cashier said I could pay the balance by card after applying the discount.
examples.zh: 收银员说打完折后，我可以「用银行卡付清余款」。

collocations: allow me to pay the balance by card
ask to pay the balance by card
choose to pay the balance by card

words.enDefinition: to make a payment using a debit card

examples.en: I asked if I could pay by debit for the books and stationery.
examples.zh: 我问书和文具能不能「用借记卡付款」。

examples.en: At the campus market, I chose to pay by debit instead of cash.
examples.zh: 在校园集市，我选择「用借记卡付款」，没有用现金。

collocations: allow customers to pay by debit
